question: Which country won the 2022 FIH Junior Women's Hockey World Cup?
solution:
The correct answer is ​__Netherlands.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• The Netherlands clinched their ninth FIH Women’s Hockey World Cup by beating Argentina 3-1 in the final on 17 July 2022.
 
• Australia won the third place match by defeating Germany to claim their first World Cup medal as well.
 
• It was the 15th edition of the Women's FIH Hockey World Cup.
 
• It was held from 1 to 17 July 2022 in Spain and the Netherlands.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**​Sports:

 
• Youth World Boxing champions Alfiya Pathan & Gitika won gold medals at the first edition of the Elorda Boxing Cup in Nur-Sultan, Kazakhstan on 4 July 2022.
 
• Archers Jyothi Surekha Vennam and Abhishek Verma won the gold medal in the compound mixed team event at the Archery World Cup 2022 Stage- 3 in Paris on 25 June 2022.
 
• Cyclist Ronaldo Singh made history by winning a silver medal in the senior category sprint event at the Asian Track Cycling Championship 2022 (41st edition) held in New Delhi.
 
• Neeraj Chopra won the gold medal at the Kuortane Games in Finland on 18 June 2022.
 
• On 14 June 2022, Chopra also broke his own national record with a throw of 89.30m at the Paavo Nurmi Games 2022.
 
• Indian para-powerlifters Manpreet Kaur and Parmjeet Kumar have won bronze medals in World Para-powerlifting 2022 Asia Oceania Open Championships.
 
• Indian weightlifter Saanapathi Gurunaidu won the gold medal in the men's 55-kilogram event at the IWF Youth World Championships in Leon, Mexico on 12 Jun'22.
